headline: Gold edges up ₹27 today, silver flat; both still well below last week
summary: Today's move is small: 24K gold rose ₹27 per gram (0.2%) to ₹13,762, and 22K rose ₹25 to ₹12,615, while silver held at ₹1,95,000 per kg. Compared with 7 days ago, gold is down about 4.1% and silver about 4.9%, and over the last 20 days silver has fallen about 11.4% from its ₹2,20,000 high on 26 October. Likely drivers include the US dollar and rupee movements and softer international prices, though the app data does not confirm the cause.
outlook: If you are buying jewellery or coins this week, prices are lower than a week ago, so compare making charges and GST across dealers rather than rushing, as prices can move either way.
